en_title: The Definitive Proof That GTA 6 and Red Dead Redemption Share The Same Universe
cn_title: 《GTA 6》与《荒野大镖客：救赎》共处同一宇宙的确凿证据
opus_summary: 文章列举了《GTA 6》中发现的七处《荒野大镖客》系列相关彩蛋，包括类似Arthur Morgan的牛仔帽、两部作品中出现的枪械公司，以及提及Blackwater和Flaco Hernández的小说。文章认为，小说中的细节证实Rockstar西部游戏的事件也是《侠盗猎车手》世界观的一部分。

paragraphs.en: From action movies to popular memes, there are dozens and dozens of Easter eggs and references to wider pop culture in GTA 6. But Rockstar has also slipped in more than a few nods to some of the studio’s previous games within Leonida. There’s a Manhunt-themed tattoo, for example, and a ludicrously convoluted secret that has already been unearthed involving a portal back to the days of Vice City. But one series is showing up more than others: Red Dead Redemption.
paragraphs.cn: 从动作电影到热门迷因，《GTA 6》中有数不清的彩蛋和对更广泛流行文化的致敬。不过，Rockstar也在Leonida藏入了不少对工作室以往游戏的致敬。例如，有一个《Manhunt》主题纹身，还有一个已经被发掘出来、复杂得离谱的秘密，涉及一道通往Vice City时代的传送门。但有一个系列出现的次数比其他系列更多：《荒野大镖客：救赎》。

paragraphs.en: We’re still working our way through finding all of them, as is the rest of the internet, but so far we’ve found seven secrets that relate to the developer’s beloved Western games. From hats and guns to road names and license plates, here are seven Red Dead Easter eggs in GTA 6.
paragraphs.cn: 我们和互联网上的其他人一样，还在努力找出所有这些彩蛋，但目前已经发现了七个与这家开发商备受喜爱的西部游戏有关的秘密。从帽子、枪支到道路名称和车牌，以下是《GTA 6》中的七个《荒野大镖客》彩蛋。

paragraphs.en: If you’re looking for hidden details about Red Dead, the Western-themed Frontier Mini Golf course is a natural place to start. While none of the holes directly tell the tale of Red Dead Revolver, Red Dead Redemption, or its prequel—aside from squinting at hole four and seeing a snowy train wreck as a tangential nod to RDR2’s prologue—there are still things to find.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你正在寻找有关《荒野大镖客》的隐藏细节，以西部为主题的Frontier Mini Golf球场自然是个适合开始的地方。虽然没有任何球洞直接讲述《Red Dead Revolver》、《荒野大镖客：救赎》或其前传的故事——除非你眯起眼睛看第四洞，把一处雪地火车残骸视为对《荒野大镖客：救赎2》序章的间接致敬——但这里仍然有东西可供发现。

paragraphs.en: We’ll get on to who can be seen roaming it in a moment, but before you even set foot inside, an Easter egg can be found. That’s because the attraction itself is located on Valentine Drive, a reference to the first major town you explore in Chapter 1 of Red Dead Redemption 2’s story. This is the location where Arthur famously drinks a few too many beers, has a bit of a dance, and looks for his friend, Lenny. Sadly, alcohol doesn’t seem to be served at this Mini Golf, although there’s nothing stopping you from bringing your own six-pack in.
paragraphs.cn: 我们稍后再说能看到谁在里面闲逛，但还没踏进球场，你就能发现一个彩蛋。因为这处景点本身位于Valentine Drive，这个名字指的是你在《荒野大镖客：救赎2》故事第一章中探索的第一个主要城镇。Arthur曾在这里多喝了几杯啤酒，跳了一会儿舞，还四处寻找他的朋友Lenny，这一幕广为人知。遗憾的是，这个迷你高尔夫球场似乎不供应酒，不过没人拦着你自己带一组六罐装啤酒进去。

paragraphs.en: Once you’re on the course, though, a little friend with a familiar face riding on his back may well walk up to you. A small chihuahua with a cowboy toy, dressed in remarkably similar clothing to what Red Dead Redemption 2 protagonist Arthur Morgan wore in many of the game’s trailers. Feel free to give the little guy a pet, too, and his gun-toting rider will look like he’s giving it a little “yeehaw”. Adorable.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，一旦进入球场，一个背上骑着熟悉面孔的小家伙很可能会走到你面前。那是一只背着牛仔玩具的小吉娃娃，玩具穿的衣服与《荒野大镖客：救赎2》主角Arthur Morgan在游戏许多预告片中所穿的衣服极为相似。你也可以尽情摸摸这个小家伙，他那位持枪的骑手看起来就像在轻声喊着「驾！」可爱极了。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps more life-sized Arthur Morgan Easter eggs are more your thing, though. Well, get yourself over to Port Gellhorn to get your hands on, and head in, one such thing. Follow the trail of signs and balloons to find a resident looking to get rid of any old tat. Hidden amongst it all, though, is a real treasure. No, not the cow-patterned Hawaiian shirt, but something that will make fans of Red Dead Redemption 2’s hearts flutter a little: a genuine cowboy hat. Not just any cowboy, either, but Arthur himself. The dark brown colour, complete with twisted rope around the rim, is unmistakable, and is now Jason or Lucia’s to wear whenever they like. An absolute bargain at $35, too.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，也许你更喜欢真人尺寸的Arthur Morgan彩蛋。那就前往Port Gellhorn，弄到并戴上这样一件东西吧。沿着标牌和气球一路走，找到一位想要清理各种旧破烂的居民。不过，这些东西当中藏着一件真正的宝贝。不，不是那件奶牛花纹的夏威夷衬衫，而是一件会让《荒野大镖客：救赎2》粉丝心跳加速的东西：一顶货真价实的牛仔帽。而且它不属于普通的牛仔，正是Arthur本人的帽子。深棕色的帽身，加上围绕帽檐的绞绳，让它一眼就能被认出来；现在Jason或Lucia想什么时候戴就能什么时候戴。而且只要35美元，绝对便宜。

paragraphs.en: As if we needed any further proof that the Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption stories take place in the same universe, the Duke Arms Company cements this. At any of Leonida’s Ammu-Nation stores, you can find weapons made by the same gun company that produced the Duke 1853 Navy Revolver in Red Dead Online. On the packaging found inside GTA 6’s gun stores, you can also spot 1853 written out in Roman numerals (MDCCCLIII) on the boxes. It just can’t be a coincidence.
paragraphs.cn: 如果我们还需要更多证据来证明《侠盗猎车手》和《荒野大镖客：救赎》的故事发生在同一个宇宙，那么Duke Arms Company就坐实了这一点。在Leonida的任何一家Ammu-Nation商店，你都能找到由同一家枪械公司制造的武器；这家公司在《荒野大镖客Online》中制造了Duke 1853 Navy Revolver。在《GTA 6》枪店内的包装盒上，你还可以看到用罗马数字写出的1853（MDCCCLIII）。这不可能只是巧合。

paragraphs.en: “The Cowboy’s Prayer is To Die Young” is a Wild West-set novel of which you can read a few pages in GTA 6. There are a few fun little details hidden within. First, a mention of Blackwater, the port city from Red Dead Redemption and its prequel, where John Marston chooses to build his ranch near to. But there’s also a familiar name to those who chose to fully engage with RDR2’s side activities.
paragraphs.cn: 《The Cowboy’s Prayer is To Die Young》是一部以美国西部蛮荒时代为背景的小说，你可以在《GTA 6》中读到其中几页。书里藏着一些有趣的小细节。首先，书中提到了Blackwater，也就是《荒野大镖客：救赎》及其前传中的港口城市，John Marston选择在它附近建造自己的牧场。此外，对于那些选择充分参与《荒野大镖客：救赎2》支线活动的玩家来说，书中还有一个熟悉的名字。

paragraphs.en: Flaco Hernández was an infamous outlaw who you can meet during the 2018 game’s “The Noblest of Men, and a Woman” stranger mission. At the end of that story, you knock on his cabin by Cairn Lake and defeat him in a duel. The book in GTA 6 recounts all of these details, confirming that the events of Rockstar’s Western games are canon in Grand Theft Auto lore. There are many copies of the book to be found around Leonida, but I spotted one at the Grayson Motel towards the north of the map in Lummox County.
paragraphs.cn: Flaco Hernández是一名臭名昭著的亡命之徒，你可以在这款2018年游戏的陌生人任务「The Noblest of Men, and a Woman」中遇到他。在那段故事的最后，你敲响他位于Cairn Lake旁的小木屋的门，并在决斗中击败他。《GTA 6》中的这本书讲述了所有这些细节，证实Rockstar西部游戏中的事件属于《侠盗猎车手》世界观的正史。Leonida各处可以找到许多本这本书，但我是在地图北部Lummox County的Grayson Motel发现一本的。

paragraphs.en: More locations from Red Dead here, as you may have spotted some vehicles roaming around Leonida that don’t sport license plates belonging to the “Goodtime State”. In fact, some of them hail from New Austin, the sandy state in Red Dead Redemption where the likes of Armadillo, Tumbleweed, and Thieves’ Landing can be found. Unfortunately, you can’t add one of these to your own car at a GTA 6 mod shop, but you can always jack someone else’s ride if you want to pretend you’re from the cowboy-adjacent state.
paragraphs.cn: 这里还有更多《荒野大镖客》中的地点，因为你可能已经注意到，Leonida境内行驶的一些车辆挂的并不是「Goodtime State」的车牌。事实上，其中一些来自New Austin，这是《荒野大镖客：救赎》中一个遍布沙地的州，Armadillo、Tumbleweed和Thieves’ Landing等地就坐落于此。遗憾的是，你无法在《GTA 6》的改装店给自己的车装上这种车牌，但如果你想假装自己来自这个与牛仔有关的州，随时可以抢别人的车。

paragraphs.en: And finally, more of a fun wink to the camera than a full-on Easter egg, there’s a band playing live shows in Leonida that must be a fan of Rockstar’s western games. Get yourself over to the Three Sheets liquor store in the starting area of Key Lento to take a look at a poster for the Rad Dads’ show. They’re heading out on a redemption tour. Rad Dads Redemption. Red Dead Redemption. Get it? There’s not much more to say about this one than that, really.
paragraphs.cn: 最后，与其说这是一个彻头彻尾的彩蛋，不如说是一次对着镜头会意眨眼的有趣举动：有一支在Leonida举办现场演出的乐队，他们一定是Rockstar西部游戏的粉丝。前往起始区域Key Lento的Three Sheets酒铺，看看Rad Dads演出的海报。他们正要展开一场救赎巡演。Rad Dads Redemption。荒野大镖客：救赎。明白了吗？说真的，除此之外，这个彩蛋也没什么可多说的了。

paragraphs.en: And those are the Red Dead secrets that we’ve found so far in GTA 6. Did we miss any? Let us know in the comments.
paragraphs.cn: 以上就是我们迄今在《GTA 6》中发现的《荒野大镖客》秘密。我们有遗漏什么吗？欢迎在评论中告诉我们。
